Build your own AI second brain step by step.

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to create an AI second brain that automatically remembers your emails, documents, meetings, notes, and conversations, then uses that information to answer questions and complete work for you.

I'll show you how to connect your existing apps, capture meeting notes automatically, search across all of your information using AI, and generate follow-up emails, project plans, spreadsheets, and presentations from a single meeting.

Whether you're looking for a better way to organize knowledge, prepare for meetings, or save time, this tutorial walks through the complete process from start to finish.
